• 400-Calorie Drinkable Meal.

    Mud Meal is a drinkable meal that provides a lot of nutrition: 400 calories, 21+ grams of protein, 20+ grams of fat.

    How to Use.

    Step 1: Scoop. Add 2 heaping scoops of Mud Meal to roughly 6-10 oz of water. Step 2: Shake or Stir. Shake in a bottle or stir in a container until consistent. Step 3: Drink!
